source: User board feedback plus manually decoded local video frames; no agent board operations

warm_run.user_report: HDMI no signal; D3/D2/D1/D0 all off; BitWriter succeeded; same-condition osd_phy_fix rollback normal
warm_run.meaning: Both PLL lock bits high, global reset low; card init incomplete. Frame start seen but HDMI core input video unlocked, input audio count 0; monitor accepted audio samples 0, TERC errors observed.

cold_tone_run.user_report: 5-second power cycle and same bit redownload: all LEDs on, still HDMI no signal; 1DA80000; long KEY1 makes D3 blink, others remain on, still no signal
cold_tone_run.meaning: Card initialized, fs_ready/display_valid/wav_primed high and captured error fields zero. Internal tone input 48000 per nominal second; frame start seen, core video lock 0. Monitor accepted audio samples/packets and CTS/N 0; TERC errors observed.
cold_tone_run.glyph_note: BB80, not 6680: B uses lower-case b-shaped seven-segment glyph with top segment off; checked multiple raw frames and status_hex595 RTL.

limits: The two videos are different runs and are not combined into a simultaneous ratio.
PLL/core/status bits and packet observer are internal RTL observations, not electrical HDMI carrier measurements.
Zero BCH/tone_bad is not evidence of correct encoding when no audio packet is accepted.
Audio metadata was read; the agent did not listen to these recordings.
LEDs record events and cannot establish receiver audio/video correctness.
